entities.summary: Frederick Mayer was an educational scientist and philosopher of the University of Redlands in California and one of the leading creativity experts. One of his most important aims was a global humanism. He was active as an author, publishing more than sixty books dealing with creativity, education and humanism. Internationally recognized creativity researcher Frederick Mayer in Vienna died. Mayer was particularly affected by the quote "Pride is not for him who loves his country, but for him who loves the whole world."
